title: Nutty Roasted Middle Eastern Eggplant Baba Ganoush
description: A paleo-friendly, roasted, and chewy Middle Eastern dish featuring vermicelli rice noodles and double-rise-bread, perfect for meal prep. This baba ganoush recipe is a delicious and healthy twist on a classic.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Place the scored eggplant on a baking sheet and roast for 30 minutes.
Let the eggplant cool, then scoop out the flesh and place it in a blender.
Add the tahini, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper to the blender and blend until smooth.
Stir in the olive oil and chopped pistachios.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked vermicelli rice noodles, toasted double-rise-bread cubes, and the eggplant mixture.
Toss everything together until the noodles and bread are well coated.
Serve the baba ganoush chilled, garnished with additional pistachios if desired.
